list.label: Request ID
list.description: Paste the X-Request-Id from a failed response, or copy it from the BM — Logs dashboard.

options.content:
Paste a **Request ID** in the box above. Every service that handled that request appears below, in order.

Where to find one: the `X-Request-Id` response header, the `requestId` field of an API error body, or any line in the **BM — Logs** dashboard.

The id is created by Nginx (or accepted from the caller), carried through the backend's MDC, and forwarded to Docling and n8n — so this is the whole story of one bill upload.

panels.title: Rest of the stack — Docling / n8n / Nginx mentioning $requestId
panels.description: These services log the forwarded header as plain text, so this is a substring match rather than a parsed field.
